quota_name: The maximum number of AddInstanceFleet API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of AddInstanceFleet requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. AddInstanceFleet adds an instance fleet to a running cluster.

quota_name: The maximum number of AddInstanceGroups API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of AddInstanceGroups requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. Adds one or more instance groups to a running cluster.

quota_name: The maximum number of AddJobFlowSteps API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of AddJobFlowSteps requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. AddJobFlowSteps adds new steps to a running cluster.

quota_name: The maximum number of AddTags API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of AddTags requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. Adds tags to an Amazon EMR resource.

quota_name: The maximum number of API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region for all EMR operations.

quota_name: The maximum number of CancelSteps API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of CancelSteps requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region.

quota_name: The maximum number of CreateSecurityConfiguration API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of CreateSecurityConfiguration requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. CreateSecurityConfiguration creates a security configuration, which is stored in the service and can be specified when a cluster is created.

quota_name: The maximum number of DeleteSecurityConfiguration API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of DeleteSecurityConfiguration requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. DeleteSecurityConfiguration deletes a security configuration.

quota_name: The maximum number of DescribeCluster API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of DescribeCluster requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. DescribeCluster provides cluster-level details including status, hardware and software configuration, VPC settings, and so on.

quota_name: The maximum number of DescribeJobFlows API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of DescribeJobFlows requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. This API is deprecated and will eventually be removed. We recommend you use ListClusters, DescribeCluster, ListSteps, ListInstanceGroups and ListBootstrapActions instead.

quota_name: The maximum number of DescribeSecurityConfiguration API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of DescribeSecurityConfiguration requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. DescribeSecurityConfiguration provides the details of a security configuration by returning the configuration JSON.

quota_name: The maximum number of DescribeStep API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of DescribeStep requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. DescribeStep provides more detail about the cluster step.

quota_name: The maximum number of GetAutoTerminationPolicy API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of GetAutoTerminationPolicy requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. GetAutoTerminationPolicy returns the auto-termination policy for an Amazon EMR cluster.

quota_name: The maximum number of GetBlockPublicAccessConfiguration API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of GetBlockPublicAccessConfiguration requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. GetBlockPublicAccessConfiguration returns the Amazon EMR block public access configuration for the account in the current region.

quota_name: The maximum number of GetClusterSessionCredentials API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of GetClusterSessionCredentials requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. GetClusterSessionCredentials provides temporary, HTTP basic credentials that are associated with a given runtime IAM role and used by a cluster with fine-grained access control activated.

quota_name: The maximum number of GetManagedScalingPolicy API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of GetManagedScalingPolicy requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. GetManagedScalingPolicy fetches the attached managed scaling policy for an Amazon EMR cluster.

quota_name: The maximum number of GetOnClusterAppUIPresignedURL API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of GetOnClusterAppUIPresignedURL requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. GetOnClusterAppUIPresignedURL returns a presigned URL for the on-cluster application user interface of an Amazon EMR cluster.

quota_name: The maximum number of GetSession API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of GetSession requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. GetSession returns details of the specified session.

quota_name: The maximum number of GetSessionEndpoint API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of GetSessionEndpoint requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. GetSessionEndpoint returns the endpoint for the specified session.

quota_name: The maximum number of ListBootstrapActions API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of ListBootstrapActions requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. ListBootstrapActions provides information about the bootstrap actions associated with a cluster.

quota_name: The maximum number of ListClusters API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of ListClusters requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. ListClusters provides the status of all clusters visible to this AWS account.

quota_name: The maximum number of ListInstanceFleets API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of ListInstanceFleets requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. ListInstanceFleets lists all available details about the instance fleets in a cluster.

quota_name: The maximum number of ListInstanceGroups API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of ListInstanceGroups requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. ListInstanceGroups provides all available details about the instance groups in a cluster.

quota_name: The maximum number of ListInstances API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of ListInstances requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. ListInstances provides information for all active EC2 instances and EC2 instances terminated in the last 30 days, up to a maximum of 2,000.

quota_name: The maximum number of ListReleaseLabels API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of ListReleaseLabels requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. ListReleaseLabels retrieves release labels of Amazon EMR services in the region.

quota_name: The maximum number of ListSecurityConfigurations API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of ListSecurityConfigurations requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. ListSecurityConfigurations lists all the security configurations visible to this account, providing their creation dates and times, and their names.

quota_name: The maximum number of ListSessions API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of ListSessions requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. ListSessions returns a list of sessions associated with the account.

quota_name: The maximum number of ListSteps API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of ListSteps requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. ListSteps provides a list of steps for the cluster in reverse order.

quota_name: The maximum number of ListSupportedInstanceTypes API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of ListSupportedInstanceTypes requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. ListSupportedInstanceTypes lists the instance types that Amazon EMR supports.

quota_name: The maximum number of ModifyCluster API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of ModifyCluster requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. ModifyCluster modifies the number of steps that can be executed concurrently for the cluster specified using ClusterID.

quota_name: The maximum number of ModifyInstanceFleet API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of ModifyInstanceFleet requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. ModifyInstanceFleet modifies the target On-Demand and target Spot capacities for the instance fleet.

quota_name: The maximum number of ModifyInstanceGroups API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of ModifyInstanceGroups requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. ModifyInstanceGroups modifies the number of nodes and configuration settings of an instance group.

quota_name: The maximum number of PutAutoScalingPolicy API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of PutAutoScalingPolicy requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. PutAutoScalingPolicy creates or updates an automatic scaling policy for a core instance group or task instance group in an Amazon EMR cluster.

quota_name: The maximum number of PutAutoTerminationPolicy API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of PutAutoTerminationPolicy requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. PutAutoTerminationPolicy creates or updates an auto-termination policy for an Amazon EMR cluster.

quota_name: The maximum number of PutBlockPublicAccessConfiguration API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of PutBlockPublicAccessConfiguration requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. PutBlockPublicAccessConfiguration creates or updates an Amazon EMR block public access configuration.

quota_name: The maximum number of PutManagedScalingPolicy API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of PutManagedScalingPolicy requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. PutManagedScalingPolicy creates or updates a managed scaling policy for an Amazon EMR cluster.

quota_name: The maximum number of RemoveAutoScalingPolicy API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of RemoveAutoScalingPolicy requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. RemoveAutoScalingPolicy removes an automatic scaling policy from a specified instance group within an EMR cluster.

quota_name: The maximum number of RemoveAutoTerminationPolicy API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of RemoveAutoTerminationPolicy requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. RemoveAutoTerminationPolicy removes an auto-termination policy from an Amazon EMR cluster.

quota_name: The maximum number of RemoveManagedScalingPolicy API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of RemoveManagedScalingPolicy requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. PutManagedScalingPolicy removes a managed scaling policy from a specified Amazon EMR cluster.

quota_name: The maximum number of RemoveTags API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of RemoveTags requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. Removes tags from an Amazon EMR resource.

quota_name: The maximum number of RunJobFlow API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of RunJobFlow requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. RunJobFlow creates and starts running a new cluster (job flow).

quota_name: The maximum number of SetKeepJobFlowAliveWhenNoSteps API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of SetKeepJobFlowAliveWhenNoSteps per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region

quota_name: The maximum number of SetTerminationProtection API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of SetTerminationProtection requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. SetTerminationProtection locks a cluster (job flow) so the EC2 instances in the cluster cannot be terminated.

quota_name: The maximum number of SetVisibileToAllUsers API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of SetVisibleToAllUsers requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. Sets the VisibleToAllUsers value, which determines whether the cluster is visible to all IAM users of the AWS account associated with the cluster.

quota_name: The maximum number of StartSession API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of StartSession requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. StartSession creates and starts a new interactive session.

quota_name: The maximum number of TerminateJobFlows API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of TerminateJobFlows requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. TerminateJobFlows shuts a list of clusters (job flows) down.

quota_name: The maximum number of TerminateSession API requests that you can make per second.
description: The maximum number of TerminateSession requests per second that you can perform in this account in the current Region. TerminateSession terminates the specified session.

quota_name: The maximum rate at which your bucket replenishes for all EMR operations.
description: The maximum rate at which your bucket replenishes for all EMR operations.
